description:
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Determined Iteration triggers, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare the Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. It triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.
